candidates.summary: Multimodal agents commonly generate freeform reasoning before each action. candidates.title: Plan or Retrieve First? A Scale Study of Tool Discovery Architectures
candidates.summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents discover relevant APIs from large registries before planning execution, yet finite context windows prohibit injecting all tool definitions into a single prompt. The dominant approach, which we term Retrieve-then-Plan (RtP), embeds the user query and retrieves similar tools via approximate nearest-neighbor search. We study an alternative Plan-then-Retrieve (PtR) paradigm in which the LLM first generates Abstract Tool Stubs (hypothesized function signatures describing needed capabilities) which then serve as retrieval queries against the registry. candidates.title: Looking for feedback and testers for Stepfork, an open-source AI agent testing tool
candidates.summary:
Hi everyone,

I’ve been building Stepfork, an open-source tool to make AI-agent failures easier to reproduce and test.

When developing AI agents, debugging a failed execution can be difficult. Even after fixing a bug, it’s easy for the same issue to return without regression tests.

Stepfork aims to help by letting developers:

  • Record AI-agent executions.

  • Replay recorded failures offline.

  • Generate pytest regression tests from recorded runs.
